description: The more9s plugin: values and standards for agentic development.

plugins.name: more9s
plugins.description: Values and standards for agentic development, as leaf skills an agent reads when a task triggers them. /make-more9s indexes them and says how they rank. Also: playbooks for multi-step work, best-practice skills for Go, Rust and TypeScript, and short operator commands such as /wat, /why and /catch-up.
